units.id: mission:Setar Fort Heating|When you arrive on <planet>, a group of Korath is waiting to unload the cargo. You try and imitate their gesture of greeting, holding your hands up with your palms toward the group. They look surprised but hiss approvingly.|126|0
units.english: When you arrive on <planet>, a group of Korath is waiting to unload the cargo. You try and imitate their gesture of greeting, holding your hands up with your palms toward the group. They look surprised but hiss approvingly.
units.italian: Quando arrivate su <planet>, un gruppo di Korath aspetta per scaricare il carico. Provate a imitare il loro gesto di saluto, sollevando le mani con i palmi verso il gruppo. Sembrano sorpresi ma sibilano in segno di approvazione.

units.id: mission:Setar Fort Heating|	Soon, all the supplies are off of your ship. The Korath give you a gesture of appreciation, then they begin unpacking it right in the middle of the spaceport. Already, a crowd has begun to gather around the equipment. It looks like it will be put to good use here. When you return to your ship, you see the Wanderer who offered you the job has transferred you your payment of <payment>.|127|0
units.english: Soon, all the supplies are off of your ship. The Korath give you a gesture of appreciation, then they begin unpacking it right in the middle of the spaceport. Already, a crowd has begun to gather around the equipment. It looks like it will be put to good use here. When you return to your ship, you see the Wanderer who offered you the job has transferred you your payment of <payment>.
units.italian: Ben presto tutte le provviste sono fuori dalla nave. I Korath vi fanno un gesto di apprezzamento, poi cominciano a disimballarle proprio in mezzo allo spazioporto. Una folla si è già radunata intorno alle attrezzature. Sembra che qui saranno usate bene. Quando tornate alla nave, vedete che il Wanderer che vi aveva offerto il lavoro vi ha trasferito il pagamento di <payment>.

units.id: mission:Korath Family to Ringworld|name|130|0
units.english: Korath to <planet>
units.italian: Korath per <planet>

units.id: mission:Korath Family to Ringworld|description|131|0
units.english: A Korath family of <bunks> has paid you <payment> to take them to the Quarg ringworld of <destination>.
units.italian: Una famiglia Korath di <bunks> persone vi ha pagato <payment> per portarla al mondo ad anello dei Quarg di <destination>.

units.id: mission:Korath Family to Ringworld|The smog is so thick on Laki Nemparu that even the brightest hours of the day feel like evening to you. Everything here is so dirty that most of the Korath look a few shades darker than those of other planets. Within minutes, a small layer of soot clings to your skin as well.|140|0
units.english: The smog is so thick on Laki Nemparu that even the brightest hours of the day feel like evening to you. Everything here is so dirty that most of the Korath look a few shades darker than those of other planets. Within minutes, a small layer of soot clings to your skin as well.
units.italian: La foschia è così fitta su Laki Nemparu che anche le ore più luminose del giorno vi sembrano sera. Tutto qui è così sporco che la maggior parte dei Korath sembra di qualche tonalità più scura rispetto a quelli di altri pianeti. Nel giro di pochi minuti anche sulla vostra pelle si attacca un sottile strato di fuliggine.

units.id: mission:Korath Family to Ringworld|	As you observe your surroundings, a Kor Efret approaches you followed by two others, one likely a child based on its size and the other hunched over a cane it uses for support - probably elderly. The one in front speaks in the Korath language and quickly realizes you don't understand it at all. The Kor Efret pauses to take a deep breath, then erupts into a coughing fit as they inhale far too much smog. It's almost a full minute before they recover.|141|0
units.english: As you observe your surroundings, a Kor Efret approaches you followed by two others, one likely a child based on its size and the other hunched over a cane it uses for support - probably elderly. The one in front speaks in the Korath language and quickly realizes you don't understand it at all. The Kor Efret pauses to take a deep breath, then erupts into a coughing fit as they inhale far too much smog. It's almost a full minute before they recover.
units.italian: Mentre osservate ciò che vi circonda, un Kor Efret vi si avvicina, seguito da altri due: uno, a giudicare dalla taglia, è probabilmente un bambino, e l'altro è curvo su un bastone che usa per sostegno, probabilmente anziano. Quello davanti parla in lingua Korath e capisce presto che non la capite affatto. Il Kor Efret si ferma a prendere un respiro profondo, poi scoppia in un accesso di tosse per aver aspirato troppa foschia. Passa quasi un minuto intero prima che si riprenda.

units.id: mission:Korath Family to Ringworld|	The Korath points up to the sky and says, "<planet>, <planet>," while gesturing to the two Korath with them. They press 500 credits into your hands and continue to mutter in the Korath language. <planet> is the name of the Quarg ringworld in Korath space. They must want transportation to it. 500 credits is shockingly low for any transport job, but based on their appearance they can't afford to pay you any more. Do you want to take them to <planet>?|142|0
units.english: The Korath points up to the sky and says, "<planet>, <planet>," while gesturing to the two Korath with them. They press 500 credits into your hands and continue to mutter in the Korath language. <planet> is the name of the Quarg ringworld in Korath space. They must want transportation to it. 500 credits is shockingly low for any transport job, but based on their appearance they can't afford to pay you any more. Do you want to take them to <planet>?
units.italian: Il Korath indica il cielo e dice: "<planet>, <planet>," mentre gesticola verso i due Korath che sono con lui. Vi premono 500 crediti nelle mani e continuano a borbottare in lingua Korath. <planet> è il nome del mondo ad anello dei Quarg nello spazio Korath. Devono volere un passaggio fin lì. 500 crediti sono scandalosamente pochi per qualunque lavoro di trasporto, ma a giudicare dal loro aspetto non possono permettersi di pagarvi di più. Volete portarli su <planet>?

units.id: mission:Korath Family to Ringworld|	(Yes.)|144|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:Korath Family to Ringworld|	(Yes, and give their credits back to them.)|145|0
units.english: (Yes, and give their credits back to them.)
units.italian: (Sì, e restituite loro i crediti.)

units.id: mission:Korath Family to Ringworld|	(No.)|147|0
units.english: (No.)
units.italian: (No.)

units.id: mission:Korath Family to Ringworld|	You pocket the credits and gesture for them to follow to your ship. When the Korath realizes you've agreed, they sigh in relief and rapidly gesture in gratitude. You show them to their bunks... and the shower.|149|0
units.english: You pocket the credits and gesture for them to follow to your ship. When the Korath realizes you've agreed, they sigh in relief and rapidly gesture in gratitude. You show them to their bunks... and the shower.
units.italian: Vi mettete i crediti in tasca e fate segno di seguirvi alla nave. Quando il Korath capisce che avete accettato, sospira di sollievo e gesticola rapidamente in segno di gratitudine. Li accompagnate alle loro cuccette... e alla doccia.

units.id: mission:Korath Family to Ringworld|	The Korath's shoulders slump when you hand back the credits, but their disappointment turns to surprise when you gesture to your ship. When they realize you're trying to refuse the money, they puff their chest out and push the credits into your hands again. They won't take no for an answer, so you pocket the credits and take them to your ship. You show them to their bunks... and the shower.|153|0
units.english: The Korath's shoulders slump when you hand back the credits, but their disappointment turns to surprise when you gesture to your ship. When they realize you're trying to refuse the money, they puff their chest out and push the credits into your hands again. They won't take no for an answer, so you pocket the credits and take them to your ship. You show them to their bunks... and the shower.
units.italian: Le spalle del Korath si abbassano quando gli restituite i crediti, ma la delusione diventa sorpresa quando fate segno verso la nave. Quando capiscono che state cercando di rifiutare il denaro, gonfiano il petto e vi spingono di nuovo i crediti in mano. Non accettano un no come risposta, così vi mettete i crediti in tasca e li portate alla nave. Li accompagnate alle loro cuccette... e alla doccia.

units.id: mission:Korath Family to Ringworld|	You give the credits back to the Korath, and their shoulders slump. You watch the trio wander off until they're no longer visible through the thick smog. You can't help but feel a little bad.|157|0
units.english: You give the credits back to the Korath, and their shoulders slump. You watch the trio wander off until they're no longer visible through the thick smog. You can't help but feel a little bad.
units.italian: Restituite i crediti al Korath e le loro spalle si abbassano. Guardate il terzetto allontanarsi finché la foschia fitta non li nasconde. Non potete fare a meno di sentirvi un po' in colpa.

units.id: mission:Korath Family to Ringworld|You enjoy the new company on your ship. The child has taught you a game where you take turns throwing a ball against the wall. You spend an hour or two playing with them in the cargo hold.|163|0
units.english: You enjoy the new company on your ship. The child has taught you a game where you take turns throwing a ball against the wall. You spend an hour or two playing with them in the cargo hold.
units.italian: Vi piace la nuova compagnia sulla nave. Il bambino vi ha insegnato un gioco in cui a turno si lancia una palla contro la parete. Passate un'ora o due a giocare con loro nella stiva.

units.id: mission:Korath Family to Ringworld|	When you arrive, you decide to accompany the family into the spaceport. Waiting near the docking bay are two more Korath, one an adult and the other elderly, and the three you've transported rush to meet them. After the happy reunion has died down, the Korath who had originally asked you for transportation turns to a nearby Quarg and says something. The Quarg responds and then turns to you.|164|0
units.english: When you arrive, you decide to accompany the family into the spaceport. Waiting near the docking bay are two more Korath, one an adult and the other elderly, and the three you've transported rush to meet them. After the happy reunion has died down, the Korath who had originally asked you for transportation turns to a nearby Quarg and says something. The Quarg responds and then turns to you.
units.italian: Quando arrivate, decidete di accompagnare la famiglia nello spazioporto. Vicino alla baia di attracco aspettano altri due Korath, uno adulto e uno anziano, e i tre che avete trasportato corrono a incontrarli. Quando la felice riunione si calma, il Korath che vi aveva chiesto il passaggio si volta verso un Quarg lì vicino e dice qualcosa. Il Quarg risponde, poi si volta verso di voi.

units.id: mission:Korath Family to Ringworld|	"This fellow pridefulest has claimed he regarded my indebted translation with reverence and asks my usage of it be preferred. I am inclined to acquiesce his request happyfully." This Quarg does not seem to have an especially strong grasp of your language, but you should be able to more or less gather what is being said. "The comrade says, 'I disproportionately thank you for reuniting my familial, in fateful service to our camaraderie.' He additionally supplants there was no method in which this gaggle would vicinitied in which absenced your presence. That is all."|165|0
units.english: "This fellow pridefulest has claimed he regarded my indebted translation with reverence and asks my usage of it be preferred. I am inclined to acquiesce his request happyfully." This Quarg does not seem to have an especially strong grasp of your language, but you should be able to more or less gather what is being said. "The comrade says, 'I disproportionately thank you for reuniting my familial, in fateful service to our camaraderie.' He additionally supplants there was no method in which this gaggle would vicinitied in which absenced your presence. That is all."
units.italian: "Questo individuo orgogliosissimo ha dichiarato che riguardava con reverenza la mia traduzione debitrice e chiede che il mio uso di essa sia preferito. Sono incline ad acconsentire alla sua richiesta felicemente." Questo Quarg non sembra avere una presa particolarmente salda della vostra lingua, ma dovreste riuscire più o meno a capire quello che viene detto. "Il camerata dice: 'Ti ringrazio sproporzionatamente per aver riunificato il mio famigliare, in servizio fatidico alla nostra camerataggine.' Aggiunge inoltre che non c'era metodo in cui questa accozzaglia sarebbe vicinata se la vostra presenza fosse stata assenziata. È tutto."

units.id: mission:Korath Family to Ringworld|	"Tell him it's no problem at all."|167|0
units.english: "Tell him it's no problem at all."
units.italian: "Ditegli che non è affatto un problema."

units.id: mission:Korath Family to Ringworld|	"Tell him he has a wonderful family, and I was glad to help."|168|0
units.english: "Tell him he has a wonderful family, and I was glad to help."
units.italian: "Ditegli che ha una famiglia meravigliosa, e che sono stato felice di aiutare."

units.id: mission:Korath Family to Ringworld|	The Quarg nods and turns to translate. The Korath responds while holding his palms toward you and moving them in a wide circular motion. "This is indicating of thankfulness of wholesomest measure. He thanks you for your fortunate words and wishes you kind travels," the Quarg says. You acknowledge the response, thank the Quarg for its (rough) translation services, and return to your ship.|169|0
units.english: The Quarg nods and turns to translate. The Korath responds while holding his palms toward you and moving them in a wide circular motion. "This is indicating of thankfulness of wholesomest measure. He thanks you for your fortunate words and wishes you kind travels," the Quarg says. You acknowledge the response, thank the Quarg for its (rough) translation services, and return to your ship.
units.italian: Il Quarg annuisce e si volta a tradurre. Il Korath risponde tenendo i palmi verso di voi e muovendoli in un ampio movimento circolare. "Questo sta a indicare gratitudine di misura sanissima. Ti ringrazia per le tue parole fortunate e ti augura viaggi gentili," dice il Quarg. Accogliete la risposta, ringraziate il Quarg per i suoi servizi di traduzione (approssimativi) e tornate alla nave.

units.id: mission:Korath Livestock|name|172|0
units.english: Livestock to <planet>
units.italian: Bestiame per <planet>

units.id: mission:Korath Livestock|description|173|0
units.english: Transport <bunks> Korath farmers and their <cargo> to <destination>. They've paid you part of your agreed 10,000 credits already.
units.italian: Trasporta <bunks> agricoltori Korath e il loro <cargo> su <destination>. Ti hanno già pagato parte dei 10.000 crediti concordati.

units.id: mission:Korath Livestock|A Kor Efret wearing several layers made of a wool-like fabric approaches you. It raises both its palms toward you, then it gestures for you to follow into an alley. You don't think it poses any threat, but it can't hurt to be cautious.|183|0
units.english: A Kor Efret wearing several layers made of a wool-like fabric approaches you. It raises both its palms toward you, then it gestures for you to follow into an alley. You don't think it poses any threat, but it can't hurt to be cautious.
units.italian: Un Kor Efret che indossa diversi strati di un tessuto simile alla lana vi si avvicina. Solleva entrambi i palmi verso di voi, poi vi fa cenno di seguirlo in un vicolo. Non pensate che rappresenti una minaccia, ma non fa male essere prudenti.

units.id: mission:Korath Livestock|	(Follow into the alleyway.)|185|0
units.english: (Follow into the alleyway.)
units.italian: (Seguilo nel vicolo.)

units.id: mission:Korath Livestock|	(Play it safe and leave.)|186|0
units.english: (Play it safe and leave.)
units.italian: (Fai il sicuro e vattene.)

units.id: mission:Korath Livestock|	The Korath weaves through the buildings, heading deeper into an abandoned section of the city. The Korath turns a corner, and as a cold wind rushes over you, an alarmingly loud bleating noise emanates from around the corner.|188|0
units.english: The Korath weaves through the buildings, heading deeper into an abandoned section of the city. The Korath turns a corner, and as a cold wind rushes over you, an alarmingly loud bleating noise emanates from around the corner.
units.italian: Il Korath si infila fra gli edifici, addentrandosi in una zona abbandonata della città. Il Korath gira un angolo, e mentre un vento freddo vi investe, da dietro l'angolo arriva un belato allarmante.

units.id: mission:Korath Livestock|	(Turn the corner.)|190|0
units.english: (Turn the corner.)
units.italian: (Gira l'angolo.)

units.id: mission:Korath Livestock|	(Turn around and try to run back to the spaceport.)|191|0
units.english: (Turn around and try to run back to the spaceport.)
units.italian: (Voltati e prova a correre allo spazioporto.)

units.id: mission:Korath Livestock|	You hear the shuffling of feet behind you and turn around. Three towering Korath wearing similar heavy clothing have stepped out of a nearby doorway and are making their way toward you. The bleating noise returns, and you turn again, only to see the original Kor Efret has returned from around the corner. Whatever chance you had of getting out of this is gone now.|192|0
units.english: You hear the shuffling of feet behind you and turn around. Three towering Korath wearing similar heavy clothing have stepped out of a nearby doorway and are making their way toward you. The bleating noise returns, and you turn again, only to see the original Kor Efret has returned from around the corner. Whatever chance you had of getting out of this is gone now.
units.italian: Sentite uno scalpiccio dietro di voi e vi voltate. Tre Korath torreggianti, con indosso abiti pesanti simili, sono usciti da una porta lì vicino e vi vengono incontro. Il belato torna, e vi voltate di nuovo, solo per vedere il Kor Efret di prima tornato da dietro l'angolo. Qualunque possibilità aveste di uscirne, ora è sparita.

units.id: mission:Korath Livestock|	The one in front turns back to where it came from, and the Korath behind you hisses and gestures forward. It looks like you should follow. You brace yourself and turn the corner to see... animals?|193|0
units.english: The one in front turns back to where it came from, and the Korath behind you hisses and gestures forward. It looks like you should follow. You brace yourself and turn the corner to see... animals?
units.italian: Quello davanti si volta verso la direzione da cui è venuto, e il Korath dietro di voi sibila e fa segno di andare avanti. Sembra che dobbiate seguirli. Vi preparate e girate l'angolo per vedere... animali?

units.id: mission:Korath Livestock|	The rusting buildings have given way to a massive abandoned plaza, and the entire space is taken up by a mix of large livestock and supplies. They remind you of sheep, but they're around five times larger, have six legs, and come in a variety of brown-black colors. Each has a full coat of fur and an additional blanket made of their own wool-like fabric on them. It's the same material these Korath are wearing. Even with their extra blanket, the "sheep" are huddled in small groups and look uncomfortably cold. They occasionally bleat loudly whenever a cold wind rushes through the plaza. Fortunately for you, these Kor Efreti look to be farmers, not muggers. This must have been the only place near the spaceport where they could keep their entire herd together.|194|0
units.english: The rusting buildings have given way to a massive abandoned plaza, and the entire space is taken up by a mix of large livestock and supplies. They remind you of sheep, but they're around five times larger, have six legs, and come in a variety of brown-black colors. Each has a full coat of fur and an additional blanket made of their own wool-like fabric on them. It's the same material these Korath are wearing. Even with their extra blanket, the "sheep" are huddled in small groups and look uncomfortably cold. They occasionally bleat loudly whenever a cold wind rushes through the plaza. Fortunately for you, these Kor Efreti look to be farmers, not muggers. This must have been the only place near the spaceport where they could keep their entire herd together.
units.italian: Gli edifici arrugginiti hanno lasciato il posto a una enorme piazza abbandonata, e tutto lo spazio è occupato da un misto di bestiame di grossa taglia e provviste. Vi ricordano delle pecore, ma sono circa cinque volte più grandi, hanno sei zampe e vengono in una varietà di colori bruno-neri. Ognuna ha un manto folto e una coperta aggiuntiva fatta del loro stesso tessuto simile alla lana. È lo stesso materiale che indossano questi Korath. Anche con la coperta in più, le "pecore" stanno accalcate in piccoli gruppi e sembrano soffrire il freddo. Belano di tanto in tanto, forte, ogni volta che un vento freddo attraversa la piazza. Per fortuna, questi Kor Efreti sembrano agricoltori, non rapinatori. Questo dev'essere l'unico posto vicino allo spazioporto dove potevano tenere insieme tutto il gregge.

units.id: mission:Korath Livestock|	The one who led you here, who also seems to be the leader, gestures for you to come over to it. It has opened a paper map - a rare sight in the era of interstellar travel. When you take a look, you realize it's not of the local area, but space; it seems to show the surrounding systems. The Korath points to one, pauses and gestures broadly at the mix of livestock and supplies, then draws its finger to another system and says something that sounds roughly like <planet>. "<planet>?" you confirm, and the Korath hisses in approval. It looks like they want transportation there. You wager the livestock and supplies will take up roughly <tons>, and there are <bunks> Korath farmers in the group.|195|0
units.english: The one who led you here, who also seems to be the leader, gestures for you to come over to it. It has opened a paper map - a rare sight in the era of interstellar travel. When you take a look, you realize it's not of the local area, but space; it seems to show the surrounding systems. The Korath points to one, pauses and gestures broadly at the mix of livestock and supplies, then draws its finger to another system and says something that sounds roughly like <planet>. "<planet>?" you confirm, and the Korath hisses in approval. It looks like they want transportation there. You wager the livestock and supplies will take up roughly <tons>, and there are <bunks> Korath farmers in the group.
units.italian: Quello che vi ha portato qui, che sembra anche essere il capo, vi fa cenno di avvicinarvi. Ha aperto una mappa di carta, una vista rara nell'era dei viaggi interstellari. Quando date un'occhiata, capite che non è della zona locale, ma dello spazio; sembra mostrare i sistemi circostanti. Il Korath ne indica uno, si ferma e gesticola ampiamente verso il misto di bestiame e provviste, poi porta il dito su un altro sistema e dice qualcosa che suona all'incirca come <planet>. "<planet>?" confermate, e il Korath sibila in approvazione. Sembra che vogliano un trasporto fin lì. Scommettete che il bestiame e le provviste occuperanno più o meno <tons>, e che nel gruppo ci siano <bunks> agricoltori Korath.

units.id: mission:Korath Livestock|	It pulls a stack of 200 credits from its pocket and sets it on the ground before drawing a circle around it with a piece of chalk. It then draws four more, makes a large circle around the five total smaller ones, then draws nine additional large circles. Your best guess is it's offering 10,000 credits for their transport.|196|0
units.english: It pulls a stack of 200 credits from its pocket and sets it on the ground before drawing a circle around it with a piece of chalk. It then draws four more, makes a large circle around the five total smaller ones, then draws nine additional large circles. Your best guess is it's offering 10,000 credits for their transport.
units.italian: Tira fuori dalla tasca un mazzo di 200 crediti e lo posa a terra, poi ci disegna intorno un cerchio con un pezzo di gesso. Ne disegna altri quattro, fa un grande cerchio intorno ai cinque più piccoli, poi disegna altri nove grandi cerchi. La vostra ipotesi migliore è che offra 10.000 crediti per il trasporto.

units.id: mission:Korath Livestock|	(Agree to take them.)|198|0
units.english: (Agree to take them.)
units.italian: (Accetta di portarli.)

units.id: mission:Korath Livestock|	(Decline the job.)|199|0
units.english: (Decline the job.)
units.italian: (Rifiuta il lavoro.)

units.id: mission:Korath Livestock|	You indicate your agreement by pointing to <planet> on the map and gesturing to yourself. Once it understands you've agreed, the Korath holds its palms toward you and moves them in a circular motion. You lead one to your ship while the rest stay behind to prepare the animals. When you arrive, it immediately goes to work spreading tarps over the floor and scattering a type of straw over them. After some time, you notice one of the "sheep" emerge from an alleyway led by a farmer that had stayed behind. Behind it is another animal, then another. The line of livestock, interspersed with the farmers keeping things moving, slowly makes it way into your hangar over the next hour.|201|0
units.english: You indicate your agreement by pointing to <planet> on the map and gesturing to yourself. Once it understands you've agreed, the Korath holds its palms toward you and moves them in a circular motion. You lead one to your ship while the rest stay behind to prepare the animals. When you arrive, it immediately goes to work spreading tarps over the floor and scattering a type of straw over them. After some time, you notice one of the "sheep" emerge from an alleyway led by a farmer that had stayed behind. Behind it is another animal, then another. The line of livestock, interspersed with the farmers keeping things moving, slowly makes it way into your hangar over the next hour.
units.italian: Indicate il vostro accordo puntando <planet> sulla mappa e gesticolando verso di voi. Quando capisce che avete accettato, il Korath tiene i palmi verso di voi e li muove in un movimento circolare. Ne portate uno alla nave mentre gli altri restano a preparare gli animali. Quando arrivate, si mette subito al lavoro stendendo teli sul pavimento e spargendoci sopra una specie di paglia. Dopo un po', notate che una delle "pecore" esce da un vicolo guidata da un agricoltore rimasto indietro. Dietro c'è un altro animale, poi un altro. La fila di bestiame, intervallata dagli agricoltori che tengono il passo, si fa lentamente strada nel vostro hangar nell'ora successiva.

units.id: mission:Korath Livestock|	As they enter your climate-controlled ship, the farmers take the hefty, wool-like blankets off the "sheep" and remove most of their own layers. One takes the entire pile of fabric to a nearby vendor and exchanges it for credits while the others go back and grab the supplies still in the plaza. By nightfall, everything and everyone is finally loaded onto your ship. The Korath who had sold the clothes to the merchant gives you the entire stack of 4,100 credits. Hopefully you'll get the rest after you get to <planet>.|202|0
units.english: As they enter your climate-controlled ship, the farmers take the hefty, wool-like blankets off the "sheep" and remove most of their own layers. One takes the entire pile of fabric to a nearby vendor and exchanges it for credits while the others go back and grab the supplies still in the plaza. By nightfall, everything and everyone is finally loaded onto your ship. The Korath who had sold the clothes to the merchant gives you the entire stack of 4,100 credits. Hopefully you'll get the rest after you get to <planet>.
units.italian: Mentre entrano nella nave a clima controllato, gli agricoltori tolgono le pesanti coperte simili alla lana dalle "pecore" e si tolgono gran parte dei loro strati. Uno porta l'intero mucchio di tessuto a un venditore lì vicino e lo scambia per crediti, mentre gli altri tornano a prendere le provviste ancora nella piazza. Al calare della notte, tutto e tutti sono finalmente caricati sulla nave. Il Korath che aveva venduto i vestiti al mercante vi consegna l'intero mazzo di 4.100 crediti. Sperate di ricevere il resto una volta arrivati su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Korath Livestock|The animals are surprisingly comfortable on the ship, but the Korath struggle. Based on how often they're in and out of the bathroom during the one-jump trip, none of them have been in hyperspace before. When they get over their space sickness, they busy themselves shaving the wool-like fur off the animals and gathering it.|211|0
units.english: The animals are surprisingly comfortable on the ship, but the Korath struggle. Based on how often they're in and out of the bathroom during the one-jump trip, none of them have been in hyperspace before. When they get over their space sickness, they busy themselves shaving the wool-like fur off the animals and gathering it.
units.italian: Gli animali stanno sorprendentemente comodi sulla nave, ma i Korath faticano. A giudicare da quante volte entrano ed escono dal bagno durante il viaggio di un salto, nessuno di loro è mai stato nell'iperspazio. Quando si riprendono dal mal di spazio, si danno da fare a radere il pelo simile alla lana dagli animali e a raccoglierlo.

units.english: As you land and open the cargo doors to reveal the hot world of <planet>, the animals shift excitedly. They seem much more energetic than any time before now, so much so that the Korath have some trouble keeping them all together as they exit the ship. The slow desertification of this planet is surely a cause for concern, but it seems to provide a much healthier environment for these animals than Setar Fort's chilling temperatures do. Once everything is off your ship, a Korath takes the wool to another vendor and again sells it, then it returns and hands you 5,900 credits. With the 4,100 credits it gave you before leaving, you've received all 10,000 promised credits. It holds its hands up with its palms toward you then leaves to join the other farmers.
units.italian: Mentre atterrate e aprite le porte del carico rivelando il caldo mondo di <planet>, gli animali si agitano eccitati. Sembrano molto più energici di qualsiasi momento precedente, tanto che i Korath fanno fatica a tenerli tutti insieme mentre escono dalla nave. La lenta desertificazione di questo pianeta è di certo motivo di preoccupazione, ma sembra offrire un ambiente molto più sano a questi animali di quanto facciano le temperature gelide di Setar Fort. Una volta che tutto è fuori dalla nave, un Korath porta la lana a un altro venditore e la vende di nuovo, poi torna e vi consegna 5.900 crediti. Con i 4.100 crediti che vi ha dato prima di partire, avete ricevuto tutti i 10.000 crediti promessi. Solleva le mani con i palmi verso di voi e poi se ne va a raggiungere gli altri agricoltori.
